selection: All transactions in each previously accepted complete Euler core emitter day; expand to all emitted logs in the enumerated archive objects. No outcome-based selection or replacement.
observation_unit: One complete source-validated transaction bundle. Every comparison arm decides only after that same bundle is available under the replay assumption.
count_baseline_change: This is a new transaction-final count baseline: add all current core logs at once, then test the trailing open-left 60-second count. It is not a byte-identical rerun of the old per-log decision rule.
time_model: Original exact block timestamp as integer event-time nanoseconds for logical replay; historical observed_time and feature_ready_time remain unknown. No actual live detection/delivery time inferred.
state_initialization: Each UTC day starts independently with empty feature/grouping state, zero notifications and one token where applicable. No state is bridged across March2-March12 or any unobserved history. The days are not independent scientific cases.
positive_reference: Each token uses only its preceding at most128 strictly positive gross external-out event-amount aggregates. Compute rank before updating. Zero/absent outflows do not enter the positive-magnitude reference.
rank: tail_rank=(1+number of preceding reference values >= current)/(reference_count+1); require at least19 preceding values; exact integer cross-multiplication, conservative ties. Fraction is not a calibrated p-value or false-alarm probability.
multi_token_rule: One transaction raw trigger if any eligible token crosses the predeclared threshold. No summation of asset units and no multiple-testing error guarantee.
grouping: First raw trigger outside the prior300-second group is one candidate and becomes the grouping anchor, even if every budget policy rejects it. Grouping does not depend on admission. Exactly the same candidate sequence feeds all9policy/budget cells of a method/day.
greedy: All B permissions available at UTC day start; emit each candidate until B has been used.
paced_cumulative: Quota at elapsed t ns is min(B,1+floor(B*t/T)) for B>0, else0, where T=86400000000000. Unused released permissions carry within this day.
token_bucket: Capacity one token, initially one; refill min(T,credit+elapsed_ns*B), costT per admitted candidate, plus separate hard daily capB. Exact integer units; no queue or retrospective release.
failure_policy: Any missing day/transaction, invalid source binding, unknown execution status, malformed observation, order violation or token-capacity overflow halts the accepted comparison. Preserve failure and partial artifacts without replacing transactions, skipping rows or tuning parameters.
labels: No labels enter source selection, scoring, grouping, history or admission. A separately frozen reported-execution join may run only after all decisions are closed; both days remain development data.
metrics: positive token observations and transactions with positive outflow
eligible token scores and cold-start token scores
transactions with at least one eligible token score
raw triggers, budget-independent group candidates and grouped triggers
emitted notifications and exact rejection reason
actual load, unused daily slots and hard-cap exceedances
first and last notification event time
exact candidate-stream equality across policies and budgets
interpretation: Functional development comparison and source-scope evidence. Unknown alerts are not negatives; no general precision, false-positive rate, independent incident recall, calibrated anomaly probability, prevented loss or production throughput is claimed. Semantic event magnitudes are not balances or economic loss.
